in_marathi.name: Thirunavukkarasu
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Temple
in_marathi.long_meaning: Thirunavukkarasu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Thirunavukkarasu means 'Lord of the Temple'. This name is derived from the Tamil language and is used in Hinduism.
